name: Carlo Felice Trossi
features: olive skin, dark hair swept back, dark eyes, long refined face, prominent nose, slim elegant build, languid aristocratic expression
bio: Count Carlo Felice Trossi di Pian Villar was president of Scuderia Ferrari, a gifted amateur and an engineer eccentric enough to design his own radial-engined, front-wheel-drive Grand Prix car in 1935. He won the 1947 and 1948 Italian Grands Prix for Alfa Romeo before a brain tumour killed him at 41.
